segment.source: Renders the top of a documentation or help home page: product name, one line on what the docs cover, a search prompt, a version badge and a short list of the pages people actually open. Use it for: developer documentation, help centres, knowledge bases, API reference landings, onboarding guides. Prefer 'Search Hero' when search is the only thing the band should carry, and 'Category Hero' for a listing page that needs no search field at all.
